title: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to delete… (CVE-2026-81542)
description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data version 5.4.0.0 contains a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to delete arbitrary files via a path traversal flaw. This vulnerability requires authentication and can lead to integrity and availability impacts without affecting confidentiality.
